meta.description: POD-NN checkpoints on validation30, N = 1024. Bounds augmented (beta0 incl.). reduced = online certificate (CYm:3x3x2 cells, compressed, Q = 36 matched to eps_N, graded eps_Q, allowance, no tightening); reduced_tightened = same / c_mu; banded_AI / exact_AI = full-order with the exact operator, no allowance. projection and pod_galerkin are reference candidates on the same basis.

pilot_N512.note: pilot metric: median rigorous reduced bound on validation30 at N = 512 with the rC:2x2 cells after ~1200 of 2000 epochs; compare with the 'reduced' column (different N, cells and Q, so indicative only)

done_when.rule: median certified bound on validation30 <= eps_N (also reported at 1e-3) for at least one lambda_R
